searched: Poly Pizza search "lizard" (Poly by Google, Quaternius, community; 72 results: salamanders, geckos, a newt, crocodilians and dinosaurs; no iguanid or spiny lizard, and Quaternius has only frogs, snakes and dinosaurs there)
OpenGameArt (web search): no CC0 or CC BY lizard; a CC BY 3.0 high-poly lizardman only
Poly Haven, Kenney: not searched in depth (neither publishes realistic small reptiles as far as known); Sketchfab not tried: downloads need an account
note: Downloaded by the fence lizard lane (agent Claude for Aaron Brodeur) to review shape and licence. Raw downloads stay local (git-ignored); only this job.json is tracked. Nothing in this folder is executed; GLB headers were read with python -I. None adopted: the mesh was generated with Meshy instead (see the entry).
